rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Closing the debate at the opening of Parliament on 30 June 1999, President Thabo Mbeki refers members to remarks made 'when the Assembly convened on June 14th and, among other things, elected the President of the Republic', and to members having been 'sworn in less than a fortnight ago'.
